recreation_prompt_markdown:
# Recreation Prompt

Recreate a mobile portrait browser game titled **World Warrior Rushdown**. Preserve a vertical arcade boss-rush shooter loop: drag horizontally to move the fighter, auto-fire upward every few frames, destroy falling hazards for score, trigger boss/rival battles at score thresholds, use a cooldown radial super to clear projectiles, lose HP on contact, and restart after knockout. Present it as a Street Fighter-inspired global tournament duel: expressive fighter silhouettes, rival archetype bosses, crowd hype scoring, guard HP, special move callouts, world-circuit flags, stage spotlights, comic hit sparks, and touch-friendly portrait UI for 4:7 to 9:16 aspect ratios.

Source prompt: Street Fighter versus fighting. A Street Fighter versus fighting game with iconic rivalries, tight combo timing, expressive character archetypes, global tournament intensity, readable special moves, and pure arcade duel drama with mobile-first controls, touch-friendly interactions, responsive readability, optimized on game start for portrait UI format, and the best-adapted mobile UX version targeting portrait aspect ratios in the 4:7 to 9:16 range.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source Game Truth
- genre: portrait canvas arcade shooter / boss-rush survival
- objective: drag the player horizontally, auto-fire, destroy falling enemies, reach score thresholds, defeat incoming bosses, survive with three HP.
- input model: touch drag or mouse movement on the canvas controls horizontal target position; a separate action button triggers a cooldown screen-clear ability.
- core loop: active play updates every animation frame; player auto-shoots every 8 frames; enemies spawn every 60 frames outside boss states; collisions update score, HP, particles, and boss progress.
- fail/friction state: enemy/body or projectile hits remove HP with invulnerability; zero HP opens game-over and restart while high score persists.

## Protected Mechanics
- Horizontal drag/mouse steering, auto-fire cadence, spawn cadence, HP count, invulnerability timing, bullet/enemy/boss collision semantics, score values, boss thresholds 30/100/200/300, boss reward +50, ability cooldown and radial bullet clear are preserved.

## Remix Blueprint
The new public surface reframes the shooter lane as a portrait arcade rivalry gauntlet: the player is a world-tour challenger throwing rising energy strikes upstage at rival archetypes. Falling enemies become rival pressure entries; bosses become named tournament rivals. The mechanics remain a vertical boss-rush shooter, but HUD, focal silhouettes, special-move language, stage crowd, flags, hit sparks, combo callouts, and mobile controls express Street Fighter-style duel drama.
